xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex50222023-09-131" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4888">sher phyin gyi man ngag gi spyi khrigs laM gsal ba'i me tog</rs> ces bya ba zab pa'i don <lb n="6b4"/> bstan pa rdzogs s+ho || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">gnyan</rs><!--<note type="editorial">Maybe <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4035">gNyan shes rab dpal</rs>, a teacher of <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">mChims</rs></note>--> gyi dpe la{s} <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">slob dpon chen po snar thang pa brgyad par byon pa</rs>s <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">smon laM tshul khriMs</rs></note> bris pa de la<!--read: las--><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6458">btsun pa <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6458">ze'u</rs></note> chos kyi rgyal mtshan</rs> gyis bris shing zhus te dag par byas pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
